description: This source file appears to contain functions related to system monitoring and graphics configuration specific to a device. It includes memory info parsing, DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) interaction to obtain display size, and general system utility functions.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a line from memory info to extract a numeric value.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Reads /proc/meminfo and retrieves the total or free memory based on the parameter.

methods.name: getPrimaryPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the primary DRM plane associated with the device.

methods.name: getGraphicSize
methods.description: Obtains the width and height of the primary display/output via DRM interfaces.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns total GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns free GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the graphics output.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the graphics output.
